effects_provenance.raw: Caked Up Candy · Greenhouse THCa Flower 14g Caked Up Candy THCa (Runtz × Caked Up Cherries) is an indica-leaning hybrid grown in the greenhouse with organic inputs. Dense, frosty buds carry the sweet candy character of Runtz with a creamy cherry edge. The nose is packed with cherry candy, sweet berries, and vanilla. The smoke follows with sugary fruit and creamy cherry, finishing with a lingering candy sweetness. Effects are happy and relaxed, starting with an easygoing head change before settling into a mellow body feel. A flavorful afternoon or evening smoke for fans of sweet Runtz and dessert strains. effects_provenance.raw: Black Zoap THCA Flower Preferred / 28g Strain Profile Black Zoap THCA Flower brings together tropical candy sweetness, bright citrus, and floral notes over an earthy kush foundation. This indica-dominant hybrid balances a sweet opening with a spicy, resinous finish for a profile that feels rich and layered. Reported effects combine an uplifted mood with mellow physical relaxation, giving Black Zoap an easygoing character suited to winding down.
